about: Every gh and git command the charters, skills and docs tell a seat to run, and the gh api commands seats ran in this workspace on 2026-10-16, each with the verdict main gives it: pass, or the door it reaches (merge, create, push, refusal). tests/test_guards.py reads each route through guards.bash with the code host stubbed: repository o/r, branch i-1-change, PR 5 with a safety gap. A guard change that moves a verdict edits this file. Placeholders in the sources are filled with o/r, 5, i-1-change and alice; workspace commands keep their repository and numbers, with local paths and pipes into local tools dropped. A route an item's acceptance names cites that item; gh's own {owner}/{repo} placeholders stay as typed, and gh fills them from the origin remote.
